headlines.title: Suspect killed after deadly Berlin terror attack
headlines.description: Berlin police shot and killed 21-year-old Abdul Ballout after authorities say he rushed at officers with a stabbing weapon while they tried to arrest him today. Police say the suspect drove a white van into dozens of people as they walked through a park. Many of the victims were attending a large Pride event. NBC News’ Valerie Castro has the latest.

headlines.title: Video helps free man from death row
headlines.description: A Louisiana man was recently released after nearly three decades on death row for a murder multiple judges now agree never happened. Jimmie Duncan won his freedom with the help of a video that the jury did not see in his trial. NBC News’ Dan Slepian reports.

headlines.title: Trump pushes elections bill
headlines.description: With 100 days until the midterms, President Trump is putting new pressure on Senate Republicans to pass a bill that could have a sweeping impact on elections. NBC News’ Julie Tsirkin reports.

headlines.title: New diplomatic push to end war with Iran
headlines.description: A new diplomatic push was underway to potentially end the war with Iran on Sunday, after a pause in fighting between the U.S. and Iran over the weekend. NBC News’ Richard Engel reports.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: Berlin police shot and killed the suspect in this weekend’s deadly attack during the city’s Pride festival after he allegedly charged at officers with a knife while they tried to arrest him Sunday, authorities said.

headlines.title: Out-of-control wildfires burn in Europe as millions brace for severe weather in the U.S.
headlines.description: Millions of people across the U.S. are on alert for severe storms on Sunday as crews in Europe rushed to put out wildfires that are burning out of control. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports.

headlines.title: Influencer killed by husband after she accused him of pedophilia on TikTok
headlines.description: Social media influencer Sara Gilson was killed by her estranged husband less than two weeks after she posted on TikTok accusing him of pedophilia, according to police and court records.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Minnesota state Sen. John Hoffman says Angie Craig sought his endorsement while he was in ICU
headlines.description: Democratic Minnesota state Sen. John Hoffman said Rep. Angie Craig, D-Minn., sought his endorsement for her Senate campaign while he was in intensive care following the June 2025 attempt on his life.

headlines.title: North Carolina woman vanishes after swim on Grenada beach vacation
headlines.description: Elizabeth Waddell, 44, of Cary, North Carolina, was last seen at Grand Anse Beach on Wednesday, the Royal Grenada Police Force said in a missing person alert issued Thursday.

headlines.title: First Kenyan-born NFL player deported, ICE says
headlines.description: Daniel Ogama Adongo, a former Indianapolis Colts linebacker from Kenya, was deported by ICE last month, the agency said in a statement, citing an overstayed visa and a history of arrests.
